title: EmberCare QBR playbook + tailored script (renewal focus)
content:
Purpose
- Draft script and slide-by-slide notes for upcoming QBR with EmberCare Health (renewal due Q2 2025).
- Align exec talking points, technical health signals, and a renewal playbook for the next 90 days.
- This is a working doc: use for rehearsals, drop-in slides, and the renewal packet.

Context / background
- Customer: EmberCare Health (regional telehealth + chronic care mgmt). Using Redwood Hosted API since 2024-09.
- Current contract: hosted API, 2 reserved endpoints for inference routing (burst enabled). Renewal window opens 2025-04-10.
- Primary contacts: CIO = Laura Chen (exec), ML Eng manager = Rafael Ortega (tech), Product lead = Nina Park (pm).
- Usage profile: daytime burst pattern; heavy chat usage for triage flows; embedding jobs nightly for diagnostics indexing.

High-level renewal objective
- Secure 12-month committed renewal for Dedicated capacity pilot (start 2025-05-01) with 15% committed discount in exchange for 6 month usage commit and co-planned performance bump.
- Get formal letter of intent (LOI) or signed SOW by 2025-04-30.

Meeting agenda (60 min)
1) 0-5 min: Quick hellos + success highlights (Priya)
2) 5-20 min: Product health & metrics (Rafael joins)
3) 20-35 min: Business impact & ROI narrative (Priya + Ethan)
4) 35-50 min: Renewal proposal + Dedicated pilot offer (Marisol)
5) 50-60 min: Risks/concerns + next steps / decision timeline (all)

Slide-by-slide script and talking points
Slide 1 - Title / Objectives
- Title: EmberCare Q2 2025 QBR - Health, Impact, and Renewal Path
- Talking points: Thank you for partnership; three goals: surface health signals, quantify business impact, agree next steps on renewal.
- Note to self: Keep under 1 minute. Mention: "we've been honored to support your triage flows at peak loads".

Slide 2 - Topline wins since last QBR
- Bullets: 1) 99.6% API availability during November–January peak, 2) Reduced median infer latency 18% after autotuner rollout, 3) Saved estimated $27k/mo through second-level caching for embeddings.
- Data callouts: call out the clinical pilot in Nov that handled 4k chats/day.
- Quick anecdote: "Nina mentioned faster patient response times during pilot week."

Slide 3 - Product health dashboard (tailored metrics)
- Metrics to show (visual): monthly token consumption, median latency p50/p95, error rate, nightly embed job success rate, average KV cache hit%.
- Current numbers (talking values): tokens/month: 42M; median latency: 120ms (p95 480ms); 99.6% availability; embed nightly success 99.2%; KV cache hit 42%.
- Talking points: highlight sustained latency improvements and where p95 spikes remain (06:00-09:00 PDT).
- Technical note: Rafael to speak ~3 minutes on root cause of morning p95 and mitigation options.

Slide 4 - Quality & safety signals
- Content: regression checks run weekly; no outbound hallucination incidents recorded in last 90 days for triage flow tests; two minor false-positive reranking cases (ticket CS-4127).
- Talking point: emphasize continuous eval harness and proposed guardrail for triage-critical intents.

Slide 5 - Business impact (ROI)
- Narrative: Faster triage => lower time-to-first-response => reduced escalations. Quantified: estimated 12% reduction in escalations month-over-month; estimated $52k annualized savings in clinician triage hours.
- Ask: "If Dedicated can guarantee p95 < 350ms during peak, estimate further 6% escalation reduction — discuss committing to a pilot?"

Slide 6 - Renewal proposal + Dedicated pilot outline
- Proposal summary: 12-month term, start 2025-05-01, Dedicated pilot for 90 days, committed baseline throughput equivalent to current 2 endpoints + 30% burst capacity, pricing: $X/month with 15% commit discount.
- Pilot objectives & SLOs: p50 target 100ms, p95 target <350ms, 99.5% availability, perf regression alerting.
- Commercial ask: LOI by 2025-04-30; signed SOW by 2025-05-15.
- Note: Marisol to lead commercial walk-through and fallback options (hosted + burst credits) if Dedicated is not immediately approved.

Slide 7 - Risk register (account-specific)
- Risk A: Budget cadence misalignment (EmberCare FY starts May) => mitigant: flexible start + invoice schedule.
- Risk B: Security/compliance review delay for Dedicated (on-prem or VPC) => mitigant: start with isolated Dedicated in Redwood host + start evidence collection now (SOC2 artifacts).
- Risk C: SLA mismatch for peak periods => mitigant: can add temporary burst credits.
- Owner column: who will lead follow-up (Laura/EmberCare finance, Priya/Redwood AE, Marisol/Redwood sales engineer).

Slide 8 - Renewal timeline & decision checkpoints
- Timeline: present offer (this QBR), LOI (by Apr 30), tech deep-dive (week of May 5), SOW sign (by May 15), Dedicated cutover (target May 29).
- Decision checkpoint calendar invites: Rafael to confirm tech-deep-dive attendees, Priya to send LOI template on 2025-02-25.

Slide 9 - Playbook: 0–30–60–90 day plan if pilot approved
- Day 0–30: onboarding: capacity sizing session, KV cache tuning, smallest quantization profile test. Deliverables: runbook, SLA runbook.
- Day 30–60: ramp & profiling: gradual traffic shift, perf tracing, custom kernel tweaks. Deliverables: perf report, rollback playbook.
- Day 60–90: validation & cutover decision: business metrics review, final SLO sign-off. Deliverable: decision memo and go/no-go.
- Roles: Redwood SE = Marisol (day-to-day), Redwood Solutions Eng = Daniel (batch/embeds), EmberCare ML = Rafael (validation).

Slide 10 - Ask / Executive talking points
- For Laura Chen (CIO): focus on predictable unit economics, risk reduction (redundant regions), compliance pathway for VPC.
- For Product execs: focus on end-user response time improvement and developer velocity.
- Suggested language for Laura: "We want predictable performance without shifting oper burden — Redwood’s Dedicated pilot lets us accomplish this within a timeboxed window."

Appendix A - Data sources & linked artifacts
- Dashboard links: production metrics (internal): /confluence/dashboards/embercare-prod-metrics (attach before final).
- Tickets referenced: CS-4127 (false positive rerank), CS-3984 (embedding job timeout, fixed).
- Financial calc sheet: TODO: attach cost model (Ethan to update numbers by 2025-02-18).

Appendix B - Objections and rebuttals (playbook language)
- Objection: "We can’t commit to year because of fiscal uncertainty." Rebuttal: Offer phased commit: 6 month pilot with an extension clause tied to measured SLOs.
- Objection: "Security review takes months." Rebuttal: Offer evidence bundle (SOC2, penetration test summary) + start with host-isolated Dedicated.

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self)
- [ ] Finalize commercial pricing numbers and discount table (Marisol) — target 2025-02-22.
- [ ] Attach up-to-date dashboard screenshot for latency trends (Ethan).
- [ ] Confirm LOI template language with legal (Daniel Kim) — targeted 2025-02-24.
- [ ] Prep 10-min tech deep-dive deck covering morning p95 spike root cause and hotfix plan (Rafael).
- [ ] Draft renewal email cadence and personalized LOI email to Laura (Priya).

Practice notes / rehearsal script snippets
- Opening line: "Laura, Nina, Rafael — thanks again for the close collaboration this past quarter. We’ll start with the numbers and then jump to how we can operationalize a Dedicated pilot so your team has predictable performance heading into FY25."
- If budget pushback: "We can stage the commitment to align with your fiscal year — the pilot gives you the ability to validate ROI before full term."
- If security ask: "We’ll provide our SOC2 package and can expedite a technical onboarding guide for your security team."

Attachment checklist for final QBR packet (pilot-ready)
- [ ] LOI template + SOW draft
- [ ] Perf dashboard screenshots (tokens, latency, errors)
- [ ] Playbook (this doc as PDF)
- [ ] Evidence bundle (SOC2 summary, pen test high level)
- [ ] Case study blurb (anonymized clinical triage win)

Meeting follow-up draft (email skeleton)
- Subject: EmberCare QBR Recap + Dedicated pilot LOI
- Body: Thanks for meeting. Key decisions: propose LOI by Apr 30; tech deep-dive week of May 5. Attached: full packet + LOI template. Next: schedule tech-deep-dive (please confirm attendees).

Notes on tone and personalization
- Keep it executive-friendly: lead with business impact, then technical validation.
- Use empathetic language: acknowledge clinical sensitivity and downtime risk.
- Keep ask explicit and timeboxed.

Version history (quick)
- 2025-02-12: initial draft (Priya)
- 2025-02-18: added metrics snapshot + playbook timeline (Ethan)
- 2025-02-20: updated ask and risk mitigations (Marisol)
